name: sleuthkit
title: The Sleuth Kit
description: Disk image forensics with The Sleuth Kit 4.12: partition tables (mmls), file system details (fsstat), file listings including deleted entries (fls), inode metadata (istat), reading a file's content by inode (icat, also deleted files), extracting it to /out, and a MAC timeline (fls + mactime). Images (raw/dd, E01 where supported) are read from the folder mounted at /work. No network.

mounts.description: The folder with the disk images (read-only is enough)
A folder for extracted files (tick writable)

notes: read_file returns at most 1 MiB of a file (text or hex); extract_file writes the whole file into /out and never overwrites. The image is only read.
